heading: Aditya Birla Sun Life Pension Fund NPS Review: Returns, Portfolio & Fees (2026)
tldr: The National Pension System (NPS) is a long-term retirement savings scheme regulated by PFRDA, offering tax benefits and flexible investment choices.
Aditya Birla Sun Life Pension Fund (ABSL) is one of the Pension Fund Managers (PFMs) for NPS subscribers.
ABSL Pension Fund has shown strong performance in government bonds (G category) over 3 to 7 years, often ranking first among peers.
Its equity (E category) performance has been mid-table compared to other PFMs in recent periods.
NPS charges are generally low, covering account opening, annual maintenance, and fund management fees.
caption:
Thinking about your retirement? It might feel far away, but starting early helps a lot. The National Pension System (NPS) is a simple way to save, and Aditya Birla Sun Life is one of the companies managing these funds. Our latest review looks at how their pension fund has performed, especially in government bonds and stocks. See if it's the right fit for your future. Read the full article to learn more!
